mode.title: Measurement mode
photon.calibrating: Calibrating the sensor on this target — do not move the KY-018.
photon.ldr_warning: The KY-018 is a photoresistor: its own response is in the milliseconds and is part of every number below. Useful to compare a setup against itself, not as an absolute click-to-photon benchmark.
photon.retry_hint: Move the sensor while watching the LIGHT number below, then press Enter to try again, or Esc to give up.
photon.status_ready: Calibration OK, the test can start.
photon.status_separation: Dark {dark} and bright {bright} are only {gap} counts apart; at least {minimum} are needed. Shade the KY-018 from the room light, raise the screen brightness, or move the sensor closer to the screen.
photon.status_uncalibrated: Not calibrated: sample black and white first.
photon.step_aim: Fix the KY-018 against the middle of the screen — elastic bands or tape — facing it, a couple of centimetres away. Then calibrate: a large target appears in the centre and both baselines are taken on it. Watch the LIGHT number on that screen: if it barely changes between black and white, the sensor is not on the target.

tip.auto_reset: Clears the firmware counters when entering test mode.
tip.baseline: The run every delta is measured against.
tip.buttons: BTN1/BTN2, firmware v1.4: BTN1 enters or leaves test mode, BTN2 clears the live run outside test mode. Presses are counted here as well.
tip.calibrate: Measures the serial round-trip and subtracts it from every sample. Run it once per session.
tip.calibrate_optical: Opens a full-screen centred target and samples black then white on it. Tape the KY-018 to the middle of the screen first and do not move it afterwards.
tip.confirm_btn2: On by default: BTN2 is a physical button and a knock on the desk should not cost you a run.
tip.demo: Simulated data. Never mixed with real runs.
tip.detect: Reads the USB product and manufacturer strings from the connected mouse.
tip.dpi: DPI cannot be read from a mouse: no Windows API exposes it. Enter it by hand from your mouse's own software.
tip.frame_cap: The target only changes on a frame boundary, so the wait for the next frame is measured instead of assumed — on average half a frame. Honest at 30/60/120; above that Tk's own jitter starts to dominate.
tip.light: KY-018 telemetry, stored with the run. It is not part of the measurement.
tip.measure_rate: Counts the mouse's actual report rate for two seconds. Move the mouse continuously while it runs. This measures what the mouse really achieves, which is not always the rate it is configured for.
tip.polling: Reported in the archive only; it does not change how the Teensy measures.
tip.probe_to_pc: The verified measurement: probe contact to the click reaching Windows.
tip.probe_to_photon: Probe contact to the screen actually turning white. Includes the display; uses the KY-018.
tip.probe_to_photon_ingame: Planned. Calibrate on a repeatable in-game event, such as a muzzle flash, and measure during normal play. Needs the photodiode front-end that is being built.
tip.target: Test mode switches to blue when this many samples are collected.
tip.threshold: Midpoint between the two baselines. The firmware stops the clock the first time the sensor crosses it.
